what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Germany.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1173192 Ukrainian refugees in Germany, 22.5% of all Ukrainian refugees and more than in any other host country.
Poland and Czechia host the next largest numbers.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every one of those years.
Before that it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory, with the DPR and LPR, from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, after a big change between 2021 and 2022.
UNHCR's figure for Germany peaked at 1205729 in 2024 and was 1173192 at the end of 2025.
Returns from Germany to Ukraine were highest in 2022 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Germany only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
